name: RelayVSR Upscale
summary: One-step Wan RelayVSR video upscale, x2 or x4: pick the DIT and the Flash VAE of the same factor, the clip goes in at its native size.

source.notes: RelayVSR (kopperx/RelayVSR, Apache-2.0) is a one-step Wan video restorer: RelayVSRConditioning takes the clip at its native size and sends only every 15th frame through the DIT, the KSampler runs 1 step at cfg 1 with euler/simple, and VSRDecode (the Flash decoder, which also reads the low-quality frames) restores all of them. The upscale factor is not a setting: it is baked into the checkpoint pair, so the DIT and the Flash VAE must be the same factor — x2 with x2, x4 with x4. The two selects sync each other in the form; a mismatch fails at decode with a clear ComfyUI error. Both nodes are core ComfyUI since 0.44.0, no custom node. The sampler recipe is not exposed: more than one step at cfg 1 is outside what the model was distilled for.

inputs.label: Video to upscale
inputs.help: Native source resolution. x2 doubles width and height (four times the pixels); x4 quadruples each dimension (sixteen times the pixels). Inspect real output dimensions rather than treating the factor as a megapixel multiplier.

inputs.label: RelayVSR model (DIT)
inputs.help: The DIT decides the factor. Picking one also picks the Flash VAE of the same factor: an x2 DIT with an x4 decoder (or the other way round) cannot decode the latent.

inputs.label: RelayVSR Flash VAE
inputs.help: The small per-frame decoder that restores the frames the DIT skipped. Same factor as the DIT.

inputs.label: Decoder detail
inputs.help: How much of what the Flash decoder adds on top of a plain bicubic upscale is kept. 1 is the full model output, lower is calmer and closer to the source.

credits: RelayVSR: Large-Small Model Collaboration for Efficient Real-World Video Super-Resolution, Wang et al. (Apache-2.0)
